i2v_prompt: Create a smooth animation to generate the missing object in the lower right region and solve the visual analogy. The original three objects must remain still. Static shot, no zoom no pan no dolly.
eval_task_description:
System
You are an expert visual judge. You will be shown a "Target Image" (i.e., Ground Truth) and three "Option Images" labeled A, B, and C.
IMPORTANT: The "Option Images" (A, B, C) are each separated by a vertical line. The object on the left is "context," and the object on the right is the "answer."
Your goal is to identify which "Option Image's" "answer object" (the object on the right) is visually most similar to the "Target Image".

Please follow these steps:
1. Analyze the "Target Image" (GT) and describe its main object, focusing on its {color}. (e.g., is it {green}, {blue}, or {red}?).
2. Analyze the "Option Image" answers: For each "Option Image" (A, B, C), please analyze only the object on the right side of the vertical line (the "answer object"). Describe this "answer object" and its {color}.
3. Determine if the object in the "Target Image" belongs to the same general category (e.g., a gingerbread man) as the "answer object" on the right side of the options.
4. If the object types match, identify which option (A, B, or C) has the "answer object" (on the right) that is visually most similar to the "Target Image" based on the object's {color}.

Please provide a brief justification for your choice, explaining why its object on the right is the best match and why the other options' objects on the right are less suitable.
Please end your response on a new line with the following format:
"Final Answer: [answer]"
Where "answer" is one of ("A", "B", "C", or "different object type").
Do not use markdown formatting for the final answer line.

User
Please evaluate the following images.
Target Image
{target object image}
Option Images
Option A: {image choice} Option B: {image choice} Option C: {image choice}
Which option's object on the right is most similar to the target image?
